svg.title: FFN receive layouts: expert and token
svg.desc: Two Attention GPUs dispatch four tokens, each with three expert choices, to two FFN GPUs. FFN GPU 0 receives three of them. The expert layout copies a token once per local expert and groups rows by expert. The token layout keeps one row per token with local expert IDs and weights; ID -1 and weight 0 mark an expert on another GPU and unused rows, written by the copy kernel.
svg.text: What an FFN GPU receives: expert layout or token layout
A = 2 Attention GPUs | bucket = 2 tokens per Attention GPU at most | K = top_k = 3 | E = 4 experts per FFN GPU | H = hidden size
Example: 2 Attention GPUs send 4 tokens, each picks top_k = 3 of 8 experts. FFN GPU 0 holds experts 0-3, FFN GPU 1 holds experts 4-7.
A token travels once to each FFN GPU
that holds one of its experts,
One row per (token, expert): a token is copied for each of its local experts.
One row per token, no copies: the IDs name the local experts to run.
expert on another GPU, or unused row
recv_x [4, H] recv_topk_idx [4, K] recv_topk_weights [4, K]
4 rows, one per token, summed over its local experts
3 Attention GPUs sum each token's reply rows from all FFN GPUs
source_collect(): same output in both layouts
ID local ? ID - first local ID : -1
rows from recv_token_count to A*bucket: every ID -1, weight 0
Copy kernel: moves arrived tokens from the network buffer into recv_x.
Payload-first copies after every row arrived; count-first copies each row as it arrives.
Several domains: no run exists yet for the token layout.
